name: 49415 · Fruitport, MI
findings: ZIP 49415 (Fruitport) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49415 (Fruitport) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
